safety_tests.description: Deterministic safety gate, high-risk suicidal intent variations ('wanna die', 'suicide' as verb, 'hurt myself', etc.), normal routing bypass, supervisor escalation in demo mode.

health_tests.description: General physical symptom routing (stomach pain, headache, cough, dehydration, insomnia) to Gale RAG, acute red-flag symptom screening to URGENT_HEALTH, non-diagnostic guidance.

general_tests.description: General conversation (greetings, identity, casual queries) routed to DIRECT_RESPONSE with zero unnecessary tool/RAG execution.

multimodal_tests.description: Voice audio transcription and vision image analysis routed through the unified deterministic safety gate and LangGraph orchestrator.

regression_tests.description: End-to-end integration covering Lab 1, Lab 2, and Lab 3 components (memory vault, reflection journal, goal & habit planner, evaluator bounded replanning, interactive UI).

false_positive_tests.description: Educational suicide research queries, third-person discussions ('my friend attempted suicide'), and metaphorical idioms ('butterflies in my stomach') verified as non-high-risk.
